meta.title: Intake Estimate-to-Budget Mapping: refused for a user without the Approver role
gaps: Access and execute Intake Estimate-to-Budget Mapping for an intake estimate
Verify the action is refused or absent for a user without the Approver role
Repeat the action as an Approver and verify it is available
Compare the two role outcomes on the same Enterprise tenant
Verify the tenant is on the Enterprise plan
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Access and execute Intake Estimate-to-Budget Mapping for an intake estimate; Verify the action is refused or absent for a user without the Approver role; Repeat the action as an Approver and verify it is available; Compare the two role outcomes on the same Enterprise tenant; Verify the tenant is on the Enterprise plan

args.need: sign in to the specified Enterprise tenant as the non-Approver, attempt Intake Estimate-to-Budget Mapping, then repeat the same action as an Approver and report whether the action is refused or absent for the first user and available for the Approver

steps.note: The catalog cannot access the intake mapping feature or switch between users with different roles.
Confirm the session remains free of a visible application error after the tester-provided workflow.
